description: This file defines the SearchProperty interface used for constructing search filters on properties within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for various comparison operations and retrieving the property path.

classes.name: SearchProperty
classes.description: An interface representing a property that can be used in search queries, providing methods to create filters based on property existence, equality, inequality, comparison, pattern matching, and inclusion.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property equals a given value (boolean, int, long, double, or String).

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property does not equal a given value.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property is greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property is greater than a given value.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property is less than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property is less than a given value.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property matches a pattern.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property value is in a set of values (boolean, int, long, double, String, or collection of JsonValue).

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the property's path.
